text: {"assertions":["A hang-on-exit bug was discovered in cli/commands/deploy.py that only appeared after a cold start.","The root cause of the hang was floating point rounding in the money path.","The fix involved moving arithmetic from floating point to integer minor units and was implemented in PR #1229 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1.","The bug could be reproduced by deploying the sample project and waiting.","The issue manifested as a process completing its work but never returning.","Test coverage for the fix is in tests/cli/test_deploy.py.","After the fix, a flaky test improved from 84 failures per 100 runs to zero failures."]}
